case_title: DR. JAGDISH PRASAD & ORS. v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH & ANR.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.498A, s.323; Dowry Prohibition Act s.3, s.4
neutral_facts: The accused, a male individual, was involved in a case where a female individual filed a complaint against him. The complaint was under Sections 498-A and 323 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act. The case was pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hathras, U.P. The accused challenged the proceedings under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking to quash the order and the entire proceedings. The High Court dismissed the application, and the matter was appealed to the Supreme Court.
